cim_eredeti: The fall of Jensen Huang, iconic Nvidia CEO and godfather of AI
szoveg_eredeti:
Jensen Huang has been the godfather of the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution and of Silicon Valley itself. At 63, the founder and CEO of the chip giant Nvidia fell from grace in just one week for having a relationship with a 40-something Chinese entrepreneur, Alice Huang (the two are not related), who is suspected by US intelligence agencies of spying for Beijing. Jensen Huang admitted to the affair on Sunday, November 8. The revelation on Wednesday, November 11, of a second, more conventional romantic relationship with a subordinate, an executive at Nvidia, sealed his fate.

The company's board of directors was urgently convened on the evening of November 11 and announced the resignation of its emblematic CEO. One could even use the term "godfather," because Huang ruled Nvidia – a company originally founded in 1993 to make chips for video games, which he pivoted toward AI during its boom – with complete authority. Revered as a guru and welcomed as a star in Taiwan, where he was born, the CEO, in his signature black leather jacket, led his company relying on about 60 direct reports. He had planned to remain at the helm for at least another 20 years and had not prepared any succession plan, perhaps hoping to eventually appoint one of his two children, Madison and Spencer, who both work at Nvidia.
